title: The Current of Mount Kessler
author: Dominic Dunmore
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
